decision_conditions: DEFINITIONS:  (Definition of 'Superstructure' and 'Practical Completion') A number of conditions attached to this permission have the time restrictions 'prior to superstructure works commencing on site' and/or 'following practical completion'.  The council considers the definition of 'superstructure' as having its normal or dictionary meaning, which is: the part of a building above its foundations.  The council considers the definition of 'practical completion' to be: when the work reaches a state of readiness for use or occupation even though there may be outstanding works/matters to be carried out.
description: Operation description: Enlargement of the existing roof at 7 Framfield Road comprising: A rear closet wing roof extension with glazed openings and zinc standing seam cladding (additional 20.5 m³); Alterations to the main mansard roof including replacement glazing; Installation of a rooflight to the mansard.
